integrity: Exact proof of signed L1 limit and sharp total variation constant; standalone numerical diagnostics are finite and do not constitute independent validation.
scientific_limitations: For fixed positive coefficient and amplitudes tending to infinity; no perturbations, boundary-coefficient limit or higher-order error. The global-center classification, exact density and weak Cauchy occupation law are prior results; priority among all unindexed writings remains unresolved.
title: Sharp total-variation Cauchy law for a cubic global center
